_source: Scryfall /cards/collection, 2026-10-17. The Zo-Zu the Punisher list of ai-prompt-eval fixture-8, the three lands a generation seated in place of its Tectonic Edge and Volatile Fault (owner report 2026-10-17), and a red non-land-destruction package (Krenko, Mob Boss and others) that stands in for the land-destruction spells in the control deck.
